Done. Here's a summary of what happened and what I did:

## Summary

**Problem:** `checkout-api` was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Current status showed v2.3.1 deployed to all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and unhealthy. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially completed (us-east rolled back, then the orchestrator halted), so I re-issued the rollback to finish us-west and eu-west.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) titled "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy" describing the failure and the rollback. (The first create call timed out, but the incident was actually created; I confirmed it via `list_incidents`.)

**Final state:** `checkout-api` is now on **v2.3.0** in all three regions, **healthy**, with error rate back down to 0.002. Incident INC-0001 remains open for follow-up on the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression.
